meta.title: MissionHub · The private referral network for recruiters
meta.description: Match your private candidates to other recruiters' open jobs. Nothing is shared until you authorize it, and every placement ends in an auditable 45/45/10 commission split.

hero.eyebrow: The private referral network for recruiters
hero.subtitle: MissionHub matches the candidates sitting in your pipeline with open roles from partner agencies. Nothing leaves your hands until you say so, and every placement ends in a clear, auditable split.
hero.note: Free to start · No candidate data shared without authorization
hero.imageAlt: Two recruiters celebrating a successful placement with a high five

statement.text: Every recruiter has great candidates that don't fit any of their own open roles. Every recruiter has roles they can't fill fast enough. MissionHub connects the two, without anyone giving away their network.

how.title: From a quiet pipeline to a shared placement.
how.subtitle: Four steps. Each one is explicit, permissioned and recorded.

one.title: Add candidates privately
one.body: Import a CSV or add profiles by hand. Record the candidate's processing authorization, then activate them for matching. They stay visible to your organization only.

two.title: Get matched to partner jobs
two.body: The engine scores your candidates against partner roles and sorts them into Strong, Potential and Not eligible, with a plain explanation of why.

three.title: Submit with authorization
three.body: Choose exactly which fields and documents to share, record the job-specific authorization, confirm the candidate's interest, and submit.

four.title: Hire and split the fee
four.body: Track interviews, offers and the hire. The commission flows through a versioned ledger: projected, payable, paid.

sides.title: Built for both ends of the referral.

owner.title: Turn idle profiles into placements.
owner.body: Candidates who aren't right for your roles are often perfect for someone else's. Find out where they fit and earn your share when they're hired.

points.b: "Why this match" breakdown for every result
points.c: You pick what's shared, field by field

owner.imageAlt: A recruiter smiling by an office window, holding a laptop

jobOwner.title: Fill roles faster with a trusted bench.
jobOwner.body: Open a role to partner referrals and see how many candidates already fit, before anyone shares a name. Review, accept or decline in one place.

points.a: Paste a job description, get suggested requirements
points.b: Anonymized match counts before referrals arrive
points.c: Accept, decline with a reason, or request info

jobOwner.imageAlt: Two recruiters working side by side at their desks

privacy.title: Anonymous until it's authorized.
privacy.subtitle: Job owners see match counts, never identities. A candidate is only revealed when their recruiter submits them, with documented consent for that specific role.

mock.hidden: Name, contact and resume stay hidden

isolation.title: Organization isolation
isolation.body: Row-level security keeps every agency's data inside its own workspace.

consent.title: Documented consent
consent.body: Processing and job-specific authorizations are recorded before anything is shared.

audit.title: Full audit trail
audit.body: Every submission, decision and ledger entry is logged and reviewable.

requests.title: Privacy requests
requests.body: Access and deletion requests are tracked with due dates, from your settings.

commissions.title: A split everyone can see coming.
commissions.subtitle: Agree on the terms before work starts. The ledger shows exactly who is owed what, at every step.

ledger.title: Placement ledger
ledger.projectedBody: Hire reported with fee and start date
ledger.payableBody: Client payment verified by the platform
ledger.paidBody: Payout receipt confirmed by the recruiter

commissions.note: No funds move through MissionHub. Payments happen between you and your partners, and the platform keeps the evidence.
commissions.configurable: Split rules are configurable and versioned.

a.q: Can other agencies see my candidates?
a.a: No. Your candidates are visible only to your organization. Job owners see anonymized match counts. A candidate is revealed only when you submit them to a specific job, sharing only the fields and documents you choose.

b.a: By default, 45% to the recruiter who sourced the candidate, 45% to the recruiter who owns the job and 10% to MissionHub. Rules are configurable and versioned, and both sides confirm a collaboration agreement before the process continues.

c.a: No funds move through the platform. You invoice your client as usual and record the evidence. Client payments are verified by the platform, and payouts are confirmed by the recruiter receiving them.

d.a: Each active candidate is compared to partner jobs on skills, seniority, location and work arrangement. Results come with an indicative score and a readable explanation, so you decide, not the algorithm.

e.a: Yes. Invite teammates with one-time links, assign roles and suspend access at any time from Settings › Team.

cta.title: Your next placement is already in someone else's pipeline.
cta.subtitle: Set up your workspace in minutes. Bring your candidates, open your roles, and start matching.
